raw_text: Prime Minister Ardern announced that the unemployment rate has fallen to 3.2%.
The Leader of the Opposition, Mr. Luxon, criticized the government's spending.
According to Finance Minister Robertson, inflation is expected to peak in the next quarter.
Dr. Seymour argued that the current regulations are stifling business growth.
The Green Party co-leader, Ms. Swarbrick, expressed concerns about climate change.
Winston Peters stated that New Zealand First will always put New Zealanders first.
The latest figures from the Ministry of Health show a decrease in Covid-19 cases.
During the debate, the Prime Minister said that their government has built 10,000 new state houses.
Christopher Luxon believes that National has a clear plan to grow the economy.
David Seymour pointed out that ACT's proposed tax cuts would benefit all New Zealanders.
Chloe Swarbrick highlighted the importance of investing in public transport.
Winston Peters claimed that immigration levels under the current government are too high.
The Minister of Education announced a new funding package for schools.
In a recent speech, Jacinda Ardern mentioned that child poverty has reduced significantly under her leadership.
Christopher Luxon questioned the government's ability to manage the national debt.
